pilot_type: development feasibility; some tasks/source groups previously observed
selection_rule: From all 102 verified metadata rows, exclude image/PDF/SVG outputs to avoid external image-judge cost; uniformly shuffle repositories, choose 10, sample one task within each using public metadata only. No outcome-based selection.
provider_pin: Z.AI FP8 through OpenRouter; no fallback to Chutes

budget.status: New study authorized by user; prior stopped study costs reported separately
budget.external_reporting_cost: official machine graders; cluster compute excluded

evaluation: official task-specific grader, immutable submission and exact public-input paths
sampling_note: GLM requires reasoning; low effort requested in all three methods. Endpoint does not support seed.
memory_policy: Reset per task; carry within the two Whole-Team cycles only. No cross-task transfer.
comparison: equal outer iterations; unequal execution counts; actual USD reported; cap-truncated runs retained
mass_fidelity: Released pipeline.search + RHI main and free-form design. Adapter replaces task paths, sandbox execution and API transport only. Fixed-reference/champion selection preserved.
calibration_stage_policy: Repeat truncated fixtures with main-study stage limits, under the unspent combined $1 integration ceiling; preserve all attempts.
